content: Riyaz Sayyad 7mo Report this post 𝐇𝐨𝐰 𝐈 𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐦𝐥𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐝 𝐦𝐲 𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐢𝐫𝐞 𝐚𝐫𝐜𝐡𝐢𝐭𝐞𝐜𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐞 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐀𝐖𝐒 𝐬𝐞𝐫𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐥𝐞𝐬𝐬 - 𝐧𝐨 𝐦𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐬𝐞𝐫𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐦𝐚𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐧𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐞, 𝐣𝐮𝐬𝐭 𝐩𝐮𝐫𝐞 𝐝𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐥𝐨𝐩𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐞𝐟𝐟𝐢𝐜𝐢𝐞𝐧𝐜𝐲. - AWS Lambda: Run code without server management; ideal for event-driven architectures and microservices. - Amazon API Gateway: Securely create and manage scalable APIs for backend services. - Amazon DynamoDB: Fully managed NoSQL database with fast, predictable performance. - AWS Step Functions: Orchestrate multiple AWS services into serverless workflows for easier application development. - Amazon S3: Scalable, durable storage for any amount of data, accessible from anywhere. - Amazon EventBridge: Build event-driven architectures by connecting data across applications and AWS services. - Amazon SNS: Easily send messages to one or more recipients, enabling seamless communication and notification across microservices. - Amazon SQS: Decouple and scale microservices, distributed systems, and serverless applications using message queues Conclusion AWS Serverless Services simplify development, automatically scale with demand, and reduce operational overhead, allowing you to focus on innovation.
